name: Mod Squares
description: A sixties tile: a square holding a diamond holding a smaller square, in three flat colors, so the corners of neighboring tiles meet as diamonds of their own.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2)); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 14.64%; background: @p(var(--color3), var(--color4)); transform: rotate(45deg); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 25%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color5)); transform: rotate(@p(0deg, 0deg, 45deg)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
